_comment: P0-03 Naver login samples. Shapes follow the official docs (developers.naver.com/docs/login/profile, /api, /devguide 3.5) checked 2026-11-03.
Values are fake. id/sub: apps registered after 2021-05-01 get a per-app BASE64 string of up to 64 chars (pairwise, differs per client_id).
Every field except response.id can be missing: the user can decline optional items, and the app may request only the 'user identifier'.

P0-04 (metadata normalization) can reuse userinfo.* as the provider=naver input. With the custom:naver OIDC approach, user_metadata holds only the id_token claims (see supabaseUserMetadata.oidc_user_metadata).

tokenResponse.id_token: <RS256 JWT, only when the OIDC endpoint /oauth2/token is used with scope=openid>

supabaseUserMetadata._comment: Observed (실측) with local GoTrue v2.197.0 + mock Naver, tests/e2e/custom-oidc.e2e.test.ts A-1. user.email is empty, app_metadata.provider = 'custom:naver', identities[0].provider = 'custom:naver', identities[0].id (auth.identities.provider_id) = sub. GoTrue copies the id_token claims as-is; no name/nickname/picture/email.
